example.title: Swan Land & Cattle Company, Barn (HABS WY-71-A)

brief: Long ranch horse barn about 40 ft wide and 80 ft deep in barn-red drop siding with white-framed six-over-six windows, under a low gable roof of weathered wood shingles that breaks to a flatter pitch over lean-to side aisles. The gable front has a big central opening with a pair of plank sliding doors on an overhead track, small loft windows and a hay door above, and a finial at the peak. Inside a central alley runs between rows of plank horse stalls with harness pegs. Heavy pole corrals, a plank stock trough and tumbleweeds surround it on bare dirt, with cottonwoods beyond.
